MARKET.SalesConcessionDescription: Utah Real Estate MLS indicates there were 38 closed sales during the past 12 months and 30 of those sales contained seller concessions which is 79% of the total transactions in this market area. Prior Months 7-12: 23 Sales; 19 with concessions; 83% of sales for this period. 4-6: 11 Sales; 9 with concessions; 82% of sales for this period. 0-3: 4 Sales; 2 with concessions; 50% of sales for this period. The concessions ranged between $200 and $18,300. The median concession amount is $9,650.
MARKET.NeighborhoodMarketabilityFactorsDescript: The data used in the grid above does not indicate there were any REO/Short sales or other distressed properties associated with the reported transactions. However, this is not a mandatory reporting field for agents and there may be some distressed sales that were not reported. MARKET.DataSourceDescription: Effective Date: 4/6/2024 Appraiser notes limitations on collecting data in this market. There is only one source of verified data; that is the Utah Real Estate Multiple Listing Service [UREMLS]. Utah is a non-discloser state and counties do not maintain sales data.
MARKET.MarketTrendsReconciliationComment: Utah Real Estate MLS reported 7 current listings with a list price range from $399,900 to $495,000, and 38 total sales in the past 12 months with a range from $239,200 to $515,000. Trend boxes are marked based on the previous 12 months. The first column represents a 6-month period while the second two columns represent 3 months each. It is more relevant indicator of the current market to consider several buying cycles. All listing status' are included in the data set this gives a better picture of the subject's overall market activity within the defined market area. Annual Average $p/sf is $311.27, while the $p/sf for 7-12 month period was $332.90, and the next 4-6 month period was $284.63, current 0-3 mon period is $260.13. Annual Median $p/sf is $327.13, while the $p/sf for the 7-12 month period was $337.71, and the next 4-6 month period was $297.41, current 0-3 month is $277.82. Recent increases in mortgage lending rates are a concern for the continued trends. It is very likely that values will be impacted as increasing mortgage rates reduce purchasing power.

SALES_COMPARISON._Comment: The comparable sales selected are the most similar disclosed sales. Adjustments reflect the different features as valued by the market and not the cost of the amenity. Typically these differences included: size, parking, baths, fireplaces, out buildings, etc. Differences in GLA were adjusted $60p/sf, which was derived as follows: Replacement cost new (Marshal&Swift/Local builder) less physical depreciation (ref to cost apprch) less market difference of 50% ($164.19-30%=$114.93-50%=$57.47 ($60r) basement shell at $20p/sf and finish by room count for utility rather than percent of finish. The number of rooms contribute more to value than does the percentage of finish and real estate agents tend to more accurately report the number of finished rooms than correctly estimating the percent of finish. Some Net and Gross adjustments are higher than ideal due to Lot size, out buildings and condition differences and a lack disclosed sales more similar in this rural area. Adjusted value range from sales comparison approach is $405,000 to $427,000(r) See additional comps and comments on next page. See comments on page 3. An attempt was made to bracket all areas of value as the market determines, i.e garage, fireplace, cooling, age, lot size & utility etc. Comparable provided as a bracketing comparable. Comps #5 & #6 are current under contract/active listings provided as part of clients scope of work. No consideration was given these listings as they are not closed sales. It is typical for sellers to pay between $200 to $18,300 in buyers closing costs, comps were adjusted at $9,650 the annual median concession paid. In the opinion of this appraiser the comparable sales presented best represent the subjects value.
